items.text: Tampa Bay (Thursday): QB Baker Mayfield (right thumb) full - starts. DNP - OLB Yaya Diaby (knee, MCL), OT Tristan Wirfs (toe), WR Chris Godwin Jr. and RB Bucky Irving (rest); WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) and RB Kenneth Gainwell (hip) upgraded to full; S Tykee Smith (ankle) limited.

Chicago (Thursday): RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) DNP again; LB D'Marco Jackson (ankle) DNP; G Joe Thuney DNP (rest); limited - DL Grady Jarrett (groin, upgraded), OL Theo Benedet (shoulder, upgraded), CB Malik Muhammad (toe). RB Zavier Scott (wrist) placed on IR. TE Cole Kmet, S Coby Bryant, DE Dayo Odeyingbo on IR.
